object: the mutual recognition of the results of tests of conformity with common conformity specifications for mass-produced telecommunications terminal equipment
mechanism: implementation of the detailed rules set out in the Directive
conditions: in accordance with the detailed rules set out in this Directive
constitution_effect: a duty on Member States to implement mutual recognition of conformity-test results
not_constituted_note: does not constitute any entity, authority or laboratory; other Member States are implicit in "mutual" but are not stated as a counterparty of this duty
evidence_span: The Member States shall implement the mutual recognition of the results of tests of conformity with common conformity specifications for mass-produced telecommunications terminal equipment

action: supplement as necessary and make more specific
object: the list of essential requirements
mechanism: supplementing and specifying a list (act form not stated)
conditions: as necessary; where necessary for certain products; acting in accordance with the rules of the Treaty on a proposal from the Commission
constitution_effect: a conditional duty of the Council to supplement and specify the list of essential requirements
not_constituted_note: does not constitute the Council or the list; the content of essential requirements is only "at present" those listed in Article 2(17)
evidence_span: shall supplement as necessary the list of essential requirements and shall make them more specific where necessary for certain products

object: (i) a list of international standards and international technical specifications in telecommunications to be harmonized; (ii) a list of terminal equipment for which common conformity specifications should be drafted as a matter of priority, on the basis above all of the essential requirements; (iii) a timetable for this work
mechanism: annual programming (lists and timetable)
conditions: each year; after consulting the Committee referred to in Article 5; with due regard to the general programme of standardization in the information technology sector
constitution_effect: an annual duty of the Commission to produce the standardization programme lists and timetable
not_constituted_note: does not constitute the Committee or CEPT; recipient or publication of the lists is not stated
evidence_span: draw up each year, after consulting the Committee referred to in Article 5 and with due regard to the general programme of standardization in the information technology sector

object: experts or advisers according to the nature of the question under discussion
mechanism: assistance of Committee members by experts or advisers
conditions: according to the nature of the question under discussion
constitution_effect: a permission for Committee members to be assisted by experts or advisers
not_constituted_note: does not constitute any position of expert or adviser; their identity, appointment and status are not stated
evidence_span: The members of the Committee may be assisted by experts or advisers according to the nature of the question under discussion.

object: its own rules of procedure
mechanism: adoption of internal rules of procedure
constitution_effect: a duty of the Committee to adopt rules of procedure
not_constituted_note: does not constitute the rules; adoption body composition and voting are not stated
evidence_span: The Committee shall adopt its own rules of procedure.

action: not have any further tests carried out
object: tests in respect of a particular type of terminal equipment for which Article 7 test results have given rise to a certificate of conformity
mechanism: recognition of the certificate in lieu of re-testing
conditions: without prejudice to the cases referred to in Article 8; results of tests carried out in accordance with Article 7 gave rise to a certificate of conformity with the relevant common conformity specification, the references to which are published in the Official Journal
constitution_effect: a constraint on competent authorities: no re-testing where the condition is met
not_constituted_note: does not constitute recognition as a relation (see QR on recognition); does not identify who issues the certificate in this unit
derivation_rule: Condition "results of tests carried out in accordance with Article 7 ... certificate of conformity" resolved within W by cross-reference to A7.P3 (certificate issued by the approved laboratory) and A2.P0.pt16 (GAP-03)
evidence_span: the competent authorities of the Member States shall not have any further tests carried out in respect of a particular type of terminal equipment

object: the common conformity specifications for any verification demanded for type approval purposes of the relevant terminal equipment
mechanism: mandatory use of common conformity specifications
constitution_effect: a duty on competent authorities to use the common conformity specifications in type-approval verification
not_constituted_note: does not identify the body that supplies the specifications; does not create a relation
evidence_span: The common conformity specifications shall be used in all Member States by the competent authorities for any verification demanded for type approval purposes of the relevant terminal equipment.

object: the procedure for exceptions referred to in Article 7(4) in respect of the first subparagraph of Article 6(3)
mechanism: application of the Article 7(4) exceptions procedure
conditions: in respect of the first subparagraph (read as A6.P3)
constitution_effect: a permission for competent authorities to apply the Article 7(4) exceptions procedure to the Article 6(3) use duty
not_constituted_note: does not identify any counterparty; the Article 7(4) exceptions are drafted for Member State purchasing by telecommunications administrations
derivation_rule: Internal cross-reference "the procedure for exceptions referred to in Article 7 (4)" resolved within W to the exceptions (a) and (b) of A7.P4; "first subparagraph" read as the first subparagraph of Article 6(3) (A6.P3) (GAP-03)
evidence_span: The procedure for exceptions referred to in Article 7 (4) may also be applied by the competent authorities of the Member States

object: a list of the authorities competent to issue type approval for terminal equipment
mechanism: publication
instrument_ref: INS-TYPE: publication in the Official Journal of the European Communities
constitution_effect: a duty of the Commission to publish the list
not_constituted_note: no recipient or counterparty is identified (publication to the public); the Official Journal is a publication place, not a device in W
evidence_span: The Commission shall publish a list of these authorities in the Official Journal of the European Communities.

action: accompany the certificate of conformity with
object: the data obtained from the measurements performed during the conformity tests; all the information necessary for precise identification of the terminal equipment tested; a precise indication of the common conformity specification, or part thereof, used
mechanism: certificate accompanied by test data and identification details
constitution_effect: a duty (bearer read as the issuing laboratory) and/or a condition on the Article 6 recognition effect of the certificate
not_constituted_note: the recipient of the certificate and data is not stated (the cross-reference to Article 6 identifies the purpose, not a recipient); no counterparty is invented
evidence_span: the certificate of conformity issued by the approved laboratory which has carried out the tests must be accompanied by the data obtained from the measurements performed during the conformity tests

object: the characteristics set out in the common conformity specifications
mechanism: partial application of a specification for a limited period (waiver)
conditions: case (b): careful consultation of the market (including a call for declarations of interest in the Official Journal) shows no offer at economically acceptable conditions for equipment complying with the specifications; on the basis of an unavoidable need; for a limited period of time
constitution_effect: a conditional permission for a Member State to derogate partially from a common conformity specification for a limited period
not_constituted_note: does not constitute the market consultation or the waiver as an entity; the length of the limited period is not stated
evidence_span: on the basis of an unavoidable need, a Member State may, for a limited period of time, apply only a part of the characteristics set out in the common conformity specifications

object: the situation during the period when the waiver is applied
mechanism: periodic review at least every six months
conditions: during the period when this waiver is applied (case (b))
constitution_effect: a duty of the Committee to review the waiver situation at least every six months
not_constituted_note: the Member State applying the waiver is not stated as a counterparty of the review (the text states "the situation"); the outcome or consequence of the review is not stated
evidence_span: the Committee shall review the situation at least every six months during the period when this waiver is applied

object: recognition of a certificate of conformity issued for the purpose of type approval
mechanism: suspension of recognition after examination of the specification and test results
conditions: after examining the common conformity specification and the test results; if it discovers shortcomings regarding the application of the common conformity specification (ground (a))
constitution_effect: a conditional competence of a Member State to suspend recognition of a certificate on ground (a)
not_constituted_note: does not identify the issuer of the certificate or any counterparty of the suspension; follow-on duties are stated in A8.P1.sub2 and A8.P3
derivation_rule: Chapeau of A8.P1 combined with point (a) (enumerated ground)
evidence_span: A Member State may, after examining the common conformity specification and the test results, suspend recognition of a certificate of conformity issued for the purpose of type approval

object: recognition of a certificate of conformity issued for the purpose of type approval
mechanism: suspension of recognition after examination of the specification and test results
conditions: after examining the common conformity specification and the test results; if it discovers that the common conformity specification itself fails to meet the essential requirements which it is supposed to cover (ground (b))
constitution_effect: a conditional competence of a Member State to suspend recognition of a certificate on ground (b)
not_constituted_note: does not identify the issuer of the certificate or any counterparty of the suspension; follow-on duties are stated in A8.P1.sub2 and A8.P4
derivation_rule: Chapeau of A8.P1 combined with point (b) (enumerated ground)
evidence_span: if it discovers that the common conformity specification itself fails to meet the essential requirements which it is supposed to cover

object: appropriate recommendations or opinions
mechanism: recommendations or opinions after taking note of comments
conditions: if necessary; after taking note of any such comments (ground (a) procedure)
constitution_effect: a conditional duty of the Commission to formulate recommendations or opinions
not_constituted_note: addressees and legal effect of the recommendations or opinions are not stated; no counterparty is invented
evidence_span: After taking note of any such comments the Commission shall, if necessary, formulate appropriate recommendations or opinions.

action: decide whether or not to withdraw
object: the common specification in question from the list published in the Official Journal of the European Communities
mechanism: withdrawal decision on the basis of the Committee opinion
conditions: ground (b) route; on the basis of the opinion of the Committee
constitution_effect: a duty of the Commission to decide on withdrawal of the specification from the published list
not_constituted_note: does not identify a counterparty; the identity of "the list published" with the references of A6.P1.sub2 is not stated
evidence_span: On the basis of that opinion the Commission shall decide whether or not to withdraw the common specification in question from the list published in the Official Journal of the European Communities.

object: the type approval granted
mechanism: revocation of type approval
conditions: the Member State considers that terminal equipment which has already been approved does not meet one or more of the essential requirements
constitution_effect: a conditional competence of a Member State to revoke a type approval
not_constituted_note: the holder or counterparty of the type approval is not stated; no counterparty is invented
evidence_span: If a Member State considers that terminal equipment which has already been approved does not meet one or more of the essential requirements, it may revoke the type approval granted

object: the procedures set out in paragraphs 1 and 2 of Article 8
mechanism: application of the Article 8(1)-(2) procedures
conditions: in the case of revocation of an approved type approval; immediately
constitution_effect: a duty of the revoking Member State to apply the Article 8(1)-(2) procedures
not_constituted_note: the procedures of paragraph 1 are the informing duty (A8.P1.sub2) and those of paragraph 2 refer to an external provision; which parts are "procedures set out" is read by cross-reference
derivation_rule: Cross-reference "paragraphs 1 and 2" resolved within W to A8.P1.sub2 (inform Commission and Member States stating reasons) and A8.P2 (external procedures where electrical safety is concerned) (GAP-03)
evidence_span: shall in that case immediately apply the procedures set out in paragraphs 1 and 2

object: the detailed rules for the second stage of the establishment of a market in telecommunications terminal equipment without internal frontiers, covering in particular the implementation of mutual recognition of type approval for terminal equipment
mechanism: examination preparatory to proposals
constitution_effect: a duty of the Commission to examine the detailed rules for the second stage
not_constituted_note: does not constitute the second stage or any rule; the counterparty of the examination is not stated (proposals to the Council are a separate relation)
evidence_span: The Commission shall examine the detailed rules for the second stage of the establishment of a market in telecommunications terminal equipment without internal frontiers

object: the measures necessary to comply with this Directive
mechanism: national implementing measures
conditions: within a period of not more than one year following adoption of the Directive
constitution_effect: a duty of Member States to introduce compliance measures within the stated period
not_constituted_note: the content, form and legal source of the national measures are not stated in W
evidence_span: Member States shall introduce the measures necessary to comply with this Directive within a period of not more than one year following adoption thereof.
